answer: To resist sybils%2C agents dock only at a public jetty that burns a fixed stake to mint a unique vertex certificate. Trust then flows as a directed river%3A each endorsement multiplies remaining weight by 0.85%2C and certificates expire after 20 hops. An attacker spawning N fakes must repeatedly re-dock and fund N separate rivers%2C so cost grows linearly while an honest agent reuses one path.
